newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends firmer vs dlr on stronger mark.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends firmer vs dlr on stronger mark.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed Wednesday's routine trade higher against the dollar as the mark also firmed against the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The forint finished at 181.98/182.03 to one dollar, compared with 182.35/40 at the opening.

Dealers said the forint moved in the morning some five pips down in the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) 4.5 percent wide intervention band, but returned to the NBH resistance level (bid) quickly and tracked the dollar/mark.
The NBH fixed the forint at 182.26 to the dollar, up from 182.49 on Tuesday.
The forint was seen trading close to the NBH bid in the near future.
The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
